entries.what: Jun opens at Heron & Grind at 6:15 and pulls Wes Arnaud's 7 a.m. cortado. After the 2:30 clock-out he stops at Ruiz Family Market for wrapper cases in aisle 6.
entries.outcome: Wrappers stocked for the weekend batch.

entries.what: Evening at Tess's house, Jun preps filling and plays old OPM ballads while Tess comments from the kitchen table.
Jun finally sits down with the county cottage food permit form at the kitchen table before his shift, ticks the boxes and submits it online.
entries.outcome: Application filed; now waiting on county review.

entries.what: Opening shift at Heron & Grind, then he tells Paolo by text that the permit is in. Paolo replies with fire emojis.
entries.outcome: Paolo excited, prep plan for Saturday confirmed.

entries.what: Between rushes Jun shows Linh how to steam milk and wants a proper training checklist for microfoam texture, so he drafts one for her at the espresso bar.
entries.outcome: Linh's foam improves; checklist taped by the steam wand.

entries.what: Wednesday evening Jun helps Tess, who is off, roll lumpia at home; her left knee acts up.
Opening shift, then Jun scrolls the Lola's Roll Instagram with Paolo's new photos over a ristretto.
entries.outcome: Chose a photo for Saturday's announcement.

entries.what: Afternoon he buys shrimp and pork at Ruiz Family Market and fills his hatchback at the Ruel Road station.

Friday after his opening shift Jun books a 3-hour commissary block at Joan's Ruel Road kitchen to prep, then sits with receipts and asks the assistant to work out cost per lumpia so he doesn't have to bug Linh again.
entries.outcome: Got a per-piece cost and a rough price check.

entries.what: Evening wrapping and frying at the commissary, scrubbing the fryer area to dodge Joan's $40 fee.
entries.outcome: Batch done and kitchen passed inspection.

entries.what: Saturday at the Saturday table at Heron & Grind, Jun sells lumpia from the end of the counter; Wes buys two and pays in quarters.
Sam texted last night to swap shifts, so Jun covers a bit of the counter; the Ridgeline hiring fair draws a line of students past the cafe.
Sunday he sleeps in, plays pickup basketball at Delgado Park and walks past the market lot, eyeing Rick's stalls.
entries.outcome: Noted where the market stalls sit.

entries.what: Family dinner at Tess's, who gives her verdict on the weekend batch and updates the coworker orders list on the fridge.
